items.title: Charlie Hamilton Interview, 1965-03-21
items.q: He wanted me and Thomas and Emmanuel Paul was already in Europe

ctx.x: Barry Martin. Yeah, he recorded me.

And he had sent for me last year, he wanted me to go to Japan in time with George and then left over there, but sometimes the deal fell through. He wanted me and Thomas and Emmanuel Paul was already in Europe, and I was supposed to meet them, but he called me the thing, fell through and it didn't come through.
Well, it'll be easier to start out from here. Yeah, yeah.
